subject: general
question: Which institution was established in 1961 to promote management education in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Indian Institute of Management (IIM)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Indian Institute of Management (IIM) was established in **1961** as part of the Indian government's initiative to promote excellence in management education and research.
 
• The first two IIMs, **IIM Calcutta** and **IIM Ahmedabad**, were set up in collaboration with international organizations such as the **Ford Foundation** and Harvard Business School.
 
• IIMs are recognized as premier institutions for management education in India, offering MBA, Executive MBA, and doctoral programs.
 
• These institutes are governed by the **Indian Institutes of Management Act, 2017**, which declared them as Institutes of National Importance.
 
• Currently, there are **20 IIMs** across India, each focusing on developing global leaders through innovative and practical management education.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Management Education in India:**

 
 
• Management education in India gained momentum post-independence to cater to the growing need for professional business leaders.
 
• It includes programs such as MBA, PGDM, Executive MBA, and specialized courses in areas like finance, marketing, and operations.
 
• Institutions like IIMs, XLRI, and ISB are leading providers of management education in the country.
 
 
 
• **Indian Institutes of Management Act, 2017:**
 
 
• The Act was enacted to provide statutory status to IIMs and empower them to grant degrees instead of diplomas.
 
• The Act enhances the autonomy of IIMs in academic, financial, and administrative matters.
 
• It designates IIMs as Institutes of National Importance, strengthening their global recognition.
 
 
 
• **Notable Contributions of IIMs:**
 
 
• IIMs have produced globally recognized leaders in business, government, and academia.
 
• They are known for their rigorous selection process, including the **CAT (Common Admission Test)**.
 
• Many IIM alumni have founded successful startups and contributed to India's entrepreneurial ecosystem.
 
 
 
• **Ford Foundation's Role:**
 
 
• The Ford Foundation played a crucial role in establishing IIMs by providing financial and technical support.
 
• Its collaboration with Harvard Business School helped shape the curriculum and pedagogy of IIM Ahmedabad.
